title: Nature camp pickup: the peacock 'tail' that isn't
storyboard: Film: parent selfie-style to camera in the car after camp pickup, natural light, 2 takes

scenes.headline: Picked her up from nature camp. She hasn't stopped talking.
The train is mostly upper tail coverts, hugely elongated
scenes.body: Indian peafowl, Jim Corbett National Park.

scenes.headline: Nature study camps for curious kids
scenes.body: Bird ID, field notes and plenty of mud. Details in bio.

caption:
POV: the car ride home from nature camp

The peacock's "tail" is a train of elongated upper tail coverts. In courtship the male raises it into a fan and makes it shimmer by vibrating it.

Source: Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Creator-style parent POV ad for nature study camps; the payoff is a real fact the kid 'brought home'. Parent is a placeholder performer - film a real parent with signed consent; camp copy to be confirmed by Muddy Lessons. peafowl/01 is a park in Hyderabad, peafowl/02 wild Corbett.
